title: Activity from a channel
description: Activity for P1 submit_activity: the sender identity verified by the channel, chat, text, file_ref attachments, reply_to. The core computes the idempotency key from (channel, update id). Forwarded and quoted text is never a command (IDN-7). If the real sender is unknown (a message on behalf of a chat, an anonymous admin), sender.verified is false and the command is not executed. Code chooses the task type, not the text.

kind.description: message from a person through a channel; signal from the monitoring adapter with the identity hook:monitor (MON-5), its fields are set by the event schema.

update_id.description: Update id at the messenger; together with the channel it is the idempotency key.

identity.description: Identity in the channel: telegram:<id>, api:<key_id>, hook:<source> or email:<address> (IDN-1).

verified.description: The channel verified the sender (signature, membership); false for a message on behalf of a chat or from an anonymous admin.

text.description: Message text; for the core this is untrusted data, except a command in the first word of a direct chat.

attachments.description: Attachments the channel has already put into the file store.

reply_to.description: Id of the message this replies to; the core uses it to look up a continuation (continues).

forwarded.description: The message is forwarded: not a command, the body gets personal_seen with source forward.

quoted.description: The message contains a quote: the quote is not a command, personal_seen source quote.
